---
pagetitle: "Noah Weidig | GIS Analyst & Data Scientist"
# Emits <meta name="description"> only; page-layout custom has no title block,
# so nothing renders on the page itself.
description: "Noah Weidig is an ecologist and GIS analyst specializing in geospatial data science, environmental modeling, and large-scale spatial analysis."
page-layout: custom
section-divs: false
toc: false
listing:
  - id: featured-projects
    contents: "projects/*/index.qmd"
    sort: "date desc"
    max-items: 6
    include:
      featured: true
    template: _ejs/project-card.ejs
  - id: featured-pubs
    contents: "publications/*/index.qmd"
    sort: "date desc"
    max-items: 4
    include:
      categories: "Journal Article"
    template: _ejs/citation.ejs
  - id: featured-posts
    contents: "blog/*/index.qmd"
    sort: "date desc"
    max-items: 3
    template: _ejs/post-row.ejs
include-after-body:
  - text: |
      <script src="assets/home.js"></script>
      <script src="assets/globe.js"></script>
      <script src="assets/hero-net.js"></script>
---
